visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video utilizes a split-screen format. In the upper half, a macro close-up shows a Coca-Cola bottle cap being flicked off, revealing the carbonated beverage inside. In the lower half, a young man with styled dark hair, wearing a black pinstripe blazer over a black t-shirt, stands in a studio with a clapperboard in the background, gesturing actively with his hands while speaking. (2) The upper frame transitions to a shot of a Coca-Cola bottle nestled in ice with yellow stylized text overlays. The host at the bottom maintains a steady gaze at the camera, his hands moving to emphasize his points. (3) A series of quick cuts in the upper frame show historical-style footage, a person holding a bottle with a red label, and a character from a TV show making a shushing gesture. The host below continues his narrative with a focused expression. (4) Liquid is seen pouring into a glass in the upper frame, creating a layer of foam and bubbles. The host continues to speak, his hands mirroring the rhythm of his speech. (5) The top frame shifts to promotional graphics for an online course, featuring a portrait of a man in glasses (JL) and several slides of text and design examples. The host in the bottom frame points upwards to reference the content above. (6) The video returns to close-up shots of cola pouring over ice cubes. Text labels for ingredients like '香草' (Vanilla) appear over images of dried pods. The host concludes the video with a questioning gesture, looking directly at the viewer.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A male voice speaks rapidly with high clarity and an engaging tone. A sharp 'pop' and 'fizz' sound of a bottle opening coincides with the start of an upbeat, medium-tempo electronic BGM track. (2) A quick 'whoosh' sound effects a transition as the narration shifts to the history of the secret formula. The BGM maintains a steady, rhythmic pulse underneath the continuous speech. (3) The sound of liquid pouring into a glass, characterized by high-frequency fizzing and bubbling, is layered over the host's voice. The vocal pitch is dynamic, conveying curiosity. (4) A short digital 'ding' signals the transition to the course advertisement. The speech rate remains fast as the host describes the professional background of the instructor. (5) The pour and fizz sounds return as the host reveals specific ingredients. The BGM continues without interruption, ending with a final percussive hit as the host asks a closing question.
